mapper.select: SELECT * FROM settlement_rule WHERE rule_code = #{ruleCode} AND org_id = #{orgId}
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_rule SET is_enabled = #{isEnabled}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE rule_id = #{ruleId}

UPDATE settlement_rule SET is_enabled = 1, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE rule_id IN
#{id}

UPDATE settlement_rule SET is_enabled = 0, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE rule_id IN
#{id}
UPDATE settlement_rule SET expire_date = #{expireDate}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE rule_id = #{ruleId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM settlement_rule WHERE is_enabled = 1 AND org_id = #{orgId} AND (effective_date IS NULL OR effective_date <= CURDATE()) AND (expire_date IS NULL OR expire_date >= CURDATE()) ORDER BY priority DESC, create_time DESC

SELECT * FROM settlement_rule WHERE is_enabled = 1 AND org_id = #{orgId} AND (effective_date IS NULL OR effective_date <= CURDATE()) AND (expire_date IS NULL OR expire_date >= CURDATE())
AND (business_type IS NULL OR business_type = #{businessType})
AND (account_id IS NULL OR account_id = #{accountId})
AND (currency_code IS NULL OR currency_code = #{currencyCode})
ORDER BY priority DESC, create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_rule SET execution_count = COALESCE(execution_count, 0) + 1, success_count = COALESCE(success_count, 0) + #{successIncrement}, last_execution_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE rule_id = #{ruleId}
mapper.select: SELECT rule_id, rule_code, rule_name, rule_type, execution_count, success_count, CASE WHEN execution_count > 0 THEN success_count * 100.0 / execution_count ELSE 0 END as success_rate, last_execution_time FROM settlement_rule WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND execution_count > 0 ORDER BY execution_count DESC

SELECT * FROM settlement_rule WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND (execution_count IS NULL OR execution_count = 0) AND create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{daysSinceCreation} DAY) ORDER BY create_time ASC

SELECT * FROM settlement_rule WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_enabled = 1 AND expire_date IS NOT NULL AND expire_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{daysBeforeExpiry} DAY) ORDER BY expire_date ASC
SELECT * FROM settlement_rule WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND expire_date IS NOT NULL AND expire_date < CURDATE() ORDER BY expire_date DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN is_enabled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as enabledCount, SUM(CASE WHEN is_enabled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as disabledCount, SUM(CASE WHEN expire_date IS NOT NULL AND expire_date < CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as expiredCount, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as usedCount, SUM(execution_count) as totalExecutions, SUM(success_count) as totalSuccesses, AVG(priority) as avgPriority FROM settlement_rule WHERE org_id = #{orgId}

SELECT rule_type, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_enabled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as enabledCount, SUM(execution_count) as totalExecutions, AVG(priority) as avgPriority FROM settlement_rule WHERE org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY rule_type ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT business_type, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_enabled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as enabledCount, SUM(execution_count) as totalExecutions, AVG(priority) as avgPriority FROM settlement_rule WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND business_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY business_type ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT DATE(last_execution_time) as date, COUNT(DISTINCT rule_id) as activeRules, SUM(execution_count) as totalExecutions, SUM(success_count) as totalSuccesses FROM settlement_rule WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND last_execution_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(last_execution_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(last_execution_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT r1.rule_id as rule1_id, r1.rule_code as rule1_code, r1.rule_name as rule1_name, r1.priority as rule1_priority, r2.rule_id as rule2_id, r2.rule_code as rule2_code, r2.rule_name as rule2_name, r2.priority as rule2_priority, 'SAME_CONDITIONS' as conflict_type FROM settlement_rule r1 JOIN settlement_rule r2 ON r1.org_id = r2.org_id WHERE r1.org_id = #{orgId} AND r1.rule_id < r2.rule_id AND r1.is_enabled = 1 AND r2.is_enabled = 1 AND r1.rule_type = r2.rule_type AND r1.business_type = r2.business_type AND ( (r1.effective_date IS NULL OR r2.expire_date IS NULL OR r1.effective_date <= r2.expire_date) AND (r2.effective_date IS NULL OR r1.expire_date IS NULL OR r2.effective_date <= r1.expire_date) ) ORDER BY r1.priority DESC, r2.priority DESC

SELECT rule_id, rule_code, rule_name, rule_condition, rule_action FROM settlement_rule WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_enabled = 1 AND ( rule_condition LIKE CONCAT('%', #{ruleCode}, '%') OR rule_action LIKE CONCAT('%', #{ruleCode}, '%') ) ORDER BY priority DESC

update.foreach: UPDATE settlement_rule SET priority = #{rule.priority}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE rule_id = #{rule.ruleId}
